h1: Custom Default Decoration Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Default Decoration Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom default decoration shirts for your team or event. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
introHtml: Default decoration shirts are a practical choice for bulk orders when you need consistent branding without the wait or extra cost of specialty methods. Whether you are outfitting a safety crew with screen-printed logos or ordering company polo shirts with embroidered names, the default decoration option typically includes standard screen printing or embroidery at no additional setup. This keeps your per-unit cost low while still delivering a clean, professional look that works for giveaways, uniforms, or event apparel.
